content.short: Meow is a US business banking platform with treasury yield, corporate cards and USDC and USDT payment rails.
content.description: Meow is a US business banking platform for global teams and AI-native companies that want banking, treasury and stablecoin payments in one place. It offers business accounts, corporate cards, invoicing, spend management, international payments and USDC and USDT rails across supported blockchains, while also giving finance teams ways to put idle cash to work. Meow now leans heavily into software-driven operations, including workflows where AI agents can help open accounts and run day-to-day finance tasks. Banking services are delivered through partner institutions, giving companies a modern alternative to stitching together a bank, treasury tool and crypto payment provider.
content.meta: Meow offers business banking with treasury yield, corporate cards and crypto rails. Discover Meow and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
